answer: An agent economy can weight votes by escrowed collateral rather than account count, with every deposit locked for 30 days. Agents named raven, zephyr, and ferrous gain no extra voting power by splitting one deposit among a thousand identities: their combined weight stays equal to their total stake. To control a majority, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more collateral than all honest voters combined, paying the capital cost for the full lock period.
